title: Deliver Me, O Lord, from Evil Men

questions.question: Deliver me, O Lord, from evil men; preserve me from whom?
Who plan evil things in their heart and stir up wars how often?
They make their tongue sharp as a serpent's, and under their lips is the venom of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 140:3 (ESV): "and under their lips is the venom of asps."

questions.question: Guard me, O Lord, from the hands of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 140:4 (ESV): "Guard me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked;"

questions.question: Who have planned to trip up my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 140:4 (ESV): "who have planned to trip up my feet."

questions.question: The arrogant have hidden a trap for me, and with cords they have spread a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 140:5 (ESV): "and with cords they have spread a net;"

questions.question: I say to the Lord, You are my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 140:6 (ESV): "I say to the Lord, You are my God;"

questions.question: O Lord, my Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 140:7 (ESV): "you have covered my head in the day of battle."

questions.question: Grant not, O Lord, the desires of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 140:8 (ESV): "Grant not, O Lord, the desires of the wicked;"

questions.question: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their lips do what to them?
questions.explanation: Psalm 140:9 (ESV): "let the mischief of their lips overwhelm them!"

questions.question: Let burning coals fall upon them! Let them be cast into fire, into miry pits, no more to do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 140:10 (ESV): "...into miry pits, no more to rise!"

questions.question: Let not the slanderer be established in the land; let evil hunt down the violent man how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 140:11 (ESV): "let evil hunt down the violent man speedily!"

questions.question: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and execute justice for the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 140:12 (ESV): "and execute justice for the needy."

questions.question: Surely the righteous shall give thanks to your name; the upright shall dwell in your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 140:13 (ESV): "the upright shall dwell in your presence."

questions.question: Who is the author of Psalm 140?
questions.explanation: Psalm 140 Title: "To the choirmaster. A Psalm of David."

key_verse_text: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and execute justice for the needy.
